gloss: small cupboard above a closet; ceiling-level storage

definitions.gloss: small cupboard near the ceiling; overhead storage above a closet
definitions.explanation: A small storage compartment built high up on the wall, typically above a Japanese-style closet (押し入れ). Found in traditional Japanese rooms, it has small sliding doors and is used for storing seldom-used items.

examples.japanese: {天袋|てんぶくろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}{外|はず}れ→季節外れ：21744_kisetsuhazure⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧しまった。
examples.english: I put out-of-season items in the overhead cupboard.

examples.japanese: {天袋|てんぶくろ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高|たか}すぎて⟦{踏|ふ}み{台|だい}→踏み台：09327_fumidai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{届|とど}かない→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: The overhead cupboard is too high to reach without a step stool.

examples.japanese: {天袋|てんぶくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けたら→開ける：00563_akeru⟧、⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アルバム→アルバム：03831_arubamu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた。
examples.english: When I opened the overhead cupboard, I found old photo albums inside.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
The {天袋|てんぶくろ} is a feature of traditional Japanese rooms (⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧), located above the {押|お}し{入|い}れ (closet) near the ceiling. The opposite is {地袋|じぶくろ}, a low cupboard built at floor level. Both are characteristic of Japanese domestic architecture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天袋|てんぶくろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しまう (to put away in the overhead cupboard)
- {天袋|てんぶくろ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to take out from the overhead cupboard)
- {天袋|てんぶくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧ (to open the overhead cupboard)

FORMS:
⟦{天|てん}→天：28464_ten⟧ (sky, ceiling, top) + {袋|ぶくろ} (bag, pouch — here meaning enclosed storage).
